description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Mirrodin Besieged and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Mirrodin Besieged trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Trading Post.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Trading Post's third ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing the Myr token, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
